PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Versatile Content Creator experienced in writing, video scripting, and visual storytelling across blogs, social
media, and brand campaigns.
SKILLS

•
Blog & SEO article writing
•
Scriptwriting for video/reels

Canva & basic graphic design
•
Content strategy & calendars
•
Keyword research (Ahrefs, SEMrush basics)
•
Brand voice development
•
Cross-platform content repurposing
WORK EXPERIENCE
Content Creator — Bloomly Lifestyle Brand
Apr 2022 - Present
•
Wrote and published 100+ blog articles, growing organic blog traffic by 60% over one year
•
Developed content calendars across Instagram, blog, and email newsletter, ensuring consistent brand voice
•
Scripted and produced 80+ short-form videos that collectively earned 2M+ views
•
Conducted keyword research that improved 15 articles to first-page Google rankings
Freelance Content Writer — Self-Employed
Jun 2020 - Mar 2022
•
Wrote SEO-optimized articles for 10+ clients across finance, travel, and wellness niches
•
Built a portfolio of 150+ published pieces across various publications and client blogs
PROJECTS
Personal Blog - MindfulMornings
Built and grew a wellness blog to 20,000 monthly readers through consistent SEO-focused content
Brand Voice Guide
Created a comprehensive brand voice and tone guide for a client to ensure content consistency
EDUCATION
B.A, English Literature — Lucknow University
2017 - 2020
CERTIFICATIONS
•
HubSpot Content Marketing Certification
•
SEMrush SEO Fundamentals Certificate
